cases.title: Discard password on Never For This Site selection
cases.description: Verify that the browser discards the password after Never For This Site is selected in the save password dialog box.

cases.title: Available choices for multiple saved credentials
cases.description: Verify that when multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved, those same choices are later available to be presented.

cases.title: Password Manager picks up changed password
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password for a website are saved and later the password is changed, the password manager picks up the new password.

cases.title: Verify disabling password manager stops password save prompts and prefilling
cases.description: Verify that when the password manager is disabled from the preferences panel, the browser no longer asks to save passwords and no longer gets prefilled info on sites.

cases.title: View saved username and password in password manager preferences
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password in the password manager are saved, this information can be successfully viewed in the password manager through the preferences panel.

cases.title: Remove site credentials stops autofill and listing
cases.description: Verify that removing a username and password for a given site ensures it no longer autofills on that site and is no longer listed in the password manager.

cases.title: Remove all username and password information
cases.description: Verify that removing all username and password information results in no autofill occurring and nothing being listed in the password manager.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases cover all requirements adequately with clear and distinct scenarios. There are no redundant cases, speculative tests, or missing operation states. All requirements map cleanly to testable high-level cases.
The test cases adequately cover all the provided requirements without any identified blockers.

analysis.analysis: R-102: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal path: selecting Never For This Site discards the password. R-103: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal path: multiple saved usernames and passwords remain available for presentation. R-104: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal path: changing a saved password allows the password manager to pick up the new password. R-105: Multiple distinct behaviors. Normal path: disabling password manager in preferences stops prompts to save passwords and stops prefilling info on sites. R-106: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal path: saved username and password can be viewed in the password manager through preferences. R-107: Multiple distinct behaviors. Normal path: removing a username and password stops autofill on that site and removes it from the password manager listing. R-108: Multiple distinct behaviors. Normal path: removing all username and password information stops all autofill and clears all listings in the password manager.
